name: guillaumechereau/goxel
description: Goxel is a free and open-source 3D voxel editor for Linux, Windows, and macOS with marching cube rendering, ray tracing, and export to OBJ, MagicaVoxel, and other formats.
score_rationale: 3.1k stars, well-established cross-platform voxel editor tool widely used by artists for voxel asset creation with broad export format support.
summary: Cross-platform voxel editor with ray tracing and multi-format export
